items.title: Dinosaur Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Rawr! It's dinosaur roleplay time! Dress up as a prehistoric creature and taunt your friends!

+ 15 dinosaur teen skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Heart Emojis
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
We love love! Wear your heart on your sleeve (and on your face!) with the new Heart Emoji skin pack. Wear one of these skins and spread the love to all of your friends.

- 6 loveable skins included <3
- By 57Digital

items.title: Kaleidoscope
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Wear one of these awe-inspiring skins! Each one is hand-crafted in an array of beautiful colors.

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Includes a free skin!
- By 57Digital

items.title: In the Clouds
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Zzzzz... is someone feeling sleepy? Then we have the dreamiest skins for you. Settle down and relax, get cosy and tucked in with these super sleepy skins. Looking for something to keep you happy from sunrise to sunset? These skins definitely (sun)rise to the occasion.

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Dream inspired skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Groovy Teens
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Become GROOVY! Meet fancy teens in this new universe of wonders. Be as cool as possible and become the most popular teen in the whole city! Groovy vibes all over the town embrace your true self in this new journey. Get ready!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Digital Mobs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Welcome to the digital age! With colors and wires alike, you'll fit right into this new world we've found ourselves in. With the Digital Mobs skin pack, you can dodge your way through the mobs and light up the world at the same time!

- 6 bright skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Mob Masks
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Blend in with your mob surroundings and act like a part of the Minecraft world with the Mob Masks skins! With these skins, no one will be able to tell you apart. Whether you're a bee, a slime, or a creeper, the choice is yours!

- 10 skins included
- Can you bee-lieve it!?
- By 57Digital

items.title: Cat Cafe
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Roleplay as a cute cat barista with the Cat Cafe skin pack! Meow!

- Hand-crafted HD skins! Perfect for cafe roleplay
- Enjoy a free skin on the house! Yep, free, nada, gratis, zilch!
- Inspired by coffee and cute cats
- By 57Digital

items.title: Element Master Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The Element Master Teens have arrived, dominating different elements, their powers are impressive! What are you waiting to acquire these amazing skins?

+16 Different Element Master Teens
by UnderBlocks

items.title: Dragon Kingdom
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Dragon Kingdom is an awesome kingdom with dragons that surround it, protecting it!

items.title: Blazes HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Play as one of your favorite mobs of the Nether- the Blaze! Fight fire with fire as a Firefighter Blaze. Rule the nether as a Demon Blaze or take on enemy mobs as a Warrior Blaze. There are many to choose from for every adventure!

items.title: Mob Slime
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Roleplay as any of these cute slime mob skins. Join your friends to form an army of slimes, or just to play your favorite maps!

items.title: Cool Kids
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
These cute teen styles are inspired by some of the game's coolest kids! 
- 12 skins

items.title: Modern Tree House
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Start your survival world in an amazing mansion built into a giant tree! Modern Tree House has many beautiful furnished rooms that are perfect to start out your survival experience.

+ Furnished rooms
+ Great with friends!

items.title: Strong Teenyboppers
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Become as powerful as these teens and reach the top! They are gym-obsessed and love fashion. Become the best of friends and enjoy the free time together, for sure you can find fun activities in the big city! Start NOW!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 teen skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Epic Friends
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Epic vibes, epic teens, and a fantastic world! Get along with these friends and become the most popular among them. Hang out in your free time, find the funniest activities in the big city and enjoy a great time together! Get ready for some actions!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 epic teen skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Heroic Youngsters
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Heroes arrived in town! Welcome into a completely new epic dimension and try to save the world by stopping one villain at a time. Protect the city from the evil forces and become the best hero in the town. Don't fear your powers, embrace them!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 teen skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Zombified Invasion
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
After a small mistake that got out of control, a group of scientists has turned the city into terrifying zombies, whether you want to be a scary zombie, a scientist or a member of security, this skinpack is perfect for you!

- 10 zombified invasion skins
- Perfect for roleplay
- By Pixelusion and CubePlanet

items.title: Sky Tower
items.creator: BTWN Creations
items.description:
Come explore this massive futuristic base! You can transport yourself up and down using future tech telepads, take in the sights from the massive view ports within the base, and enjoy the comforts of futuristic living. 

- Craftable and functional telepad elevators
- Mini bio domes to explore
- Convenient nether hub
- by BTWN Creations

items.title: Spring Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
The season is in for a change and whats a good way to match? A new set of skins!

*12 Spring Teens
*2 skins free

items.title: Emoji Ninjas
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Whether you want to laugh or cry, or show off your ninja moves. You can do both with this cool pack! 

*12 emoji ninjas
*2 skins free

items.title: Anime Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Live like you're in an anime with this pack of teens!

*12 anime teens
*2 skins free

items.title: TECHNOMANCY Vol. 1
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Metal and bone become one in this skin pack of teched-up undead adventurers, warriors, and scientists. So suit up: You're getting a second chance at life in this new body that's half machine, half spooky.

- Includes 7 skins!
- Each skin is unique, colorful, and downright incredible in detail

- By MSTRYFE & Pathway Studios

items.title: Asphalt Reinvent
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
It's time to hit the race track, and what better way to get behind the wheel than with this skin pack of stylish jumpsuits designed to make you more aerodynamic? Well, maybe that last bit isn't true, but you'll still look flashy when you snag that photo finish!

- Includes 8 HD skins!
- Each jumpsuit is unique, detailed, and stylish
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios
